newsitem.title: USA: Gantos says calendar shift hurt sales.
newsitem.headline: Gantos says calendar shift hurt sales.

text.p: Gantos Inc said Thursday its December sales were hurt by having five fewer shopping days between Thanksgiving and Christmas.

The women's apparel specialty retailer said comparable store sales for the five weeks that ended January 4 reached $25.4 million, down 11 percent from the $28.4 million one year ago. Total sales were $25.5 million, versus $28.4 million, Gantos said.
"Sales results for the Christmas period were disappointing," said Arlene Stern, president and chief executive officer of Gantos, said.
The company's shares were down 5/16 at three.
